verses.text: Sura toi ngkai kai' tau tolu: Paulus, Silas pai' Timotius, kipakatu tilou hi koi' ompi'–ompi' hampepangalaa'-kai to hi Tesalonika, to mepue'-mi hi Alata'ala to Tuama pai' hi Pue' Yesus Kristus! Wori' tabe: mekakae-kai hi Alata'ala bona nagane'-koi ngkai kabula rala-na pai' nawai'-koi kalompea' tuwu'.
Uma-kai putu mpo'uli' tarima kasi hi Alata'ala sabana koi' ompi', pai' kiporalasampaya oa'-koi.

Ane mosampaya-kai hi Alata'ala Tuama-ta, kikiwoi oa' pobago-ni to nipobago sabana pepangala'-ni, pai' kikiwoi wo'o petulungi-ni hi doo sabana ahi'-ni, pai' kikiwoi kantaha-ni hi rala pebalinaia' apa' ncarumaka-koi hi karata-na nculii' Yesus Kristus Pue'-ta.
Ki'inca moto ompi', Alata'ala mpoka'ahi'-koi pai' napelihi-mokoi jadi' bagia-na.

Ki'inca toe apa' uma kiparata kareba mara hi koi' ompi'. Kareba Lompe' to kiparata-kokoi toe, kiparata hante baraka' ngkai Inoha' Tomoroli'. Pai' kiparasaya mpu'u kamakono-na Kareba Lompe' toe. Ni'inca moto kehi-kai pai' petulungi-kai hi koi' bula-kai hi retu-pidi wengi dohe-ni. Kehi-kai toe-le mpakanoto-kokoi kamakono-na Kareba to kikeni.

Pai' koi' ompi', kani'epe-na Kareba Lompe' toe, nituku'-mi kehi-kai, pai' kehi-na Pue' Yesus wo'o. Apa' nau' rabalinai' gaga-koi, goe' oa' nono-ni mpotarima Kareba Lompe' toe. Inoha' Tomoroli'-hana to mpowai'-koi kagoea' tetu-e ompi'.
Jadi', kehi-ni tetu rapotonco hawe'ea ompi' hampepangalaa'-ta to hi tana' Makedonia pai' Akhaya.

Apa' ntepu'u ngkai koi', Lolita Pue' rapalele hobo' hi Makedonia pai' Akhaya. Meliu ngkai toe, pepangala'-ni hi Alata'ala rapotompo'wiwi hiapa–apa. Hiapa pomakoa'-kai, ra'inca ami'-mi pue' ngata tutura-na, beiwa kanipangala'-na Kareba Lompe' to kikeni-kokoi. Uma mingki' ki'uli' ba apa–apa, apa' rapotompo'wiwi ami'-mi kanibahakai-nami mpopue' pinotau, pai' megoli-mokoi mepue' hi Alata'ala to makono pai' to tuwu' liu–liu.
Rapotompo'wiwi wo'o kampopea-ni karata-na nculii' Yesus Ana' Alata'ala ngkai suruga. Alata'ala mpotuwu'-i nculii', pai' Hi'a-mi to mpobahaka-ta ngkai roe Alata'ala to mporumpa' ihi' dunia' toi mpai'.
Ni'inca moto ompi' uma-wakai lenge' mara mpokeni Kareba Lompe' hi koi'.

Kako'ia-kai rata hi ngata-ni retu, rabalinai' pai' raruge'-kai hi ngata Filipi--ni'inca moto-mi tutura-na ompi'. Aga nau' wori' to mpo'ewa-kai, Alata'ala mporohoi nono-kai bona bia'-kai mpoparata Kareba Lompe' to ngkai Alata'ala hi koi' wo'o.
Uma kibawai-koi mpotuku' tudui' to uma makono. Uma wo'o ria patuju nono-kai to dada'a, uma-kai doko' mpobagiu ba hema–hema.
Uma wo'o-kai mololita mpakagoe' nono manusia'-wadi. Mololita-kai bona mpakagoe' nono Alata'ala, apa' Hi'a-mi to mpoparesa' nono-kai, pai' na'uli' kanatao-kai mpokeni Kareba Lompe' toe.
Ni'inca moto ompi', uma-kai ria mololita mpolinuruhi-koi, uma-kai mpolerui patuju to dada'a doko' mporata ba napa–napa ngkai koi'. Alata'ala moto sabi'-kai!
Uma wo'o-kai mpope'une' hi koi' ba hi tau ntani'-na. Kakoo–kono-na, uma-kai sala' mperapii'-koi ompi', apa' suro-na Kristus mpu'u-kai.
Aga uma kibabehi hewa toe. Bula-kai retu-pidi wengi, mo'alusu' po'ingku-kai, hewa hadua totina mpewili' ana'-na.
Kiparata-kokoi Kareba Lompe' ngkai Alata'ala. Pai' meliu ngkai toe, ba tuwu' ba mate-kai, bate sadia-kai mpotulungi-koi, apa' kipoka'ahi' lia-koi.
Tantu nikiwoi moto ompi' kamowewa-kai wengi mobago, hinamengi hina'eo-kai mpali' pongkoni'-kai, bona neo'-kai mposesei'-koi bula-kai mpotudui'-koi Kareba Lompe' to ngkai Alata'ala.
Ni'inca moto kamoroli' po'ingku-kai wengi hi koi' to mepangala'-mi hi Pue' Yesus. Monoa' po'ingku-kai, uma ria kasalaia'-na. Koi'-mi sabi'-kai ompi', hante Alata'ala wo'o.
Ni'inca moto pepewili'-kai hi koi' butu dua-ni, hewa hadua tuama mpewili' ana'–ana'-na. Kirohoi pai' ki'apui nono-ni,
pai' kiparesai' mpu'u-koi bona po'ingku-ni masipato' hi ntodea-na Alata'ala. Apa' Alata'ala mpokio'-koi jadi' ntodea-na hi rala Kamagaua'-na bona mporata-koi bagia hi rala kabohe tuwu'-na.

Ria-pi hanyala to mpakeni-kai mpo'uli' tarima kasi oa' hi Alata'ala. Apa' kareba to ni'epe ngkai kai' nitarima hewa Lolita Alata'ala mpu'u, uma nitarima hewa lolita manusia'-wadi. Pai' bate wae mpu'u, kareba toe bate Lolita Alata'ala to mobago ncuu hi rala nono-ni to mepangala' hi Pue'.

Ki'inca toe ompi', apa' napa to jadi' hi to Kristen hi tana' Yudea to mepue' hi Alata'ala, wae wo'o to jadi' hi koi'. Koi' rabalinai' hingka ngata-ni moto, wae wo'o ompi'-ta to napobagia Kristus Yesus hi Yudea toera rabalinai' hingka to Yahudi-ra.

To Yahudi toe wo'o-ra-wadi to mpopatehi nabi–nabi owi pai' mpopatehi Pue' Yesus, duu'-na kai' wo'o-mi rabalinai' to Yahudi toera. Me'ewa ncuu-ra hi konoa Alata'ala, pai' jadi' bali' hawe'ea tauna-ramo.

Apa' ralawa'–lawa' ncuu ohea-kai bona ngalai' neo' kiparata kareba to mpokeni kalompea' hi tauna to bela-ra to Yahudi Jadi', ngkai hawe'ea gau'-ra to Yahudi toe, melabi rahi-mi jeko'-ra, pai' ka'omea-na mporata-ramo roe Alata'ala.

Ompi'–ompi', ngkai pogaa'-ta to hampai' tohe'i-e, lentora lia-kai mpokalentorai-koi. Nau' mogaa'-ta hi mata, aga kipoimata–mata oa'-koi hi rala nono-kai. Jadi', kipali'-mi ohea-kai tilou mpencuai'-koi.
Ria mpu'u-mi wengi hawa'-kai ke tilou mpencuai'-koie. Aku' Paulus, ba hangkuja ngkani-ama moliwo tilou, aga Magau' Anudaa' melawa'.

Doko' mpu'u-kai mpencuai'-koi, apa' ane rata-ipi mpai' Pue'-ta Pue' Yesus, pai'-ta morumpu hi nyanyoa-na, koi'-mi to jadi' wua' bago-kai to kisarumaka. Nto'u toe mpai', goe' pai' bohe nono-kai sabana koi' ompi'.
Bate koi'-mile kabohea pai' kagoea' nono-kaie!

Ka'omea-na, uma-pi kidadahi kalentora-kai. Toe pai' ki'uli', agina aku' mepopea hi ngata Atena, pai' ompi'-ta Timotius kipahawa' tilou hi koi' ompi'–ompi' hi Tesalonika. Timotius toei, doo hampobagoa-kai hi rala pobago Alata'ala, apa' natulungi-kai mpokeni Kareba Kristus. Jadi', kipahawa' mpu'u-imi Timotius tilou, ki'uli'-ki: "Iko-mi to hilou mpokinomo ompi'-ta hi Tesalonika, nurohoi pai' nupomotede' pepangala'-ra."

Kipahawa'-i tilou toe, bona neo' mpai' ria haduaa to mokalingka pepangala'-ra sabana pebalinai' to mporumpa'-koi. Apa' ta'inca moto ompi', pebalinai' to mporumpa'-ta toe, gati patuju Alata'ala ami'-mi hi kita' to Kristen.
Bula-kai retu-pidi wengi, ki'uli' ami'-mi karia-ra mpai' to mpobalinai'-ta. Hiaa' madupa' mpu'u-mi, hewa to ni'inca moto-mi ompi'.

Jadi', toe-die pai' kuhubui-i Timotius tilou-e, bona ku'inca kabeiwa-na pepangala'-ni, apa' uma mpu'u-pi kudadahi kalentora-ku. Pai' koro'-a, nee–neo' nasori Magau' Topesori-koi duu'-na napanawu'-koi pai' uma-pi ria kalaua lenge'-kai mpokeni Kareba Lompe' hi koi'.

Jadi', hewa toe lau, rata nculii'-imi Timotius hi rehe'i, pai' naparata-mikakai kareba to mpakagoe'-kai. Na'uli': "To Tesalonika toera ria, moroho moto pepangala'-ra pai' ahi'-ra. Rapolio oa'-ta pai' lentora wo'o-ra-rawo doko' mpohirua'-taka, hewa kita' wo'o doko' mpohirua'-raka."
Mpo'epe kareba to nakeni Timotius toe, tetanta'u-makai ompi'. Nau' rabalinai' pai' rapakasusa'-kai hi rei, tetanta'u oa' nono-kai mpo'epe kamoroho-na pepangala'-ni.
Jadi', morawa-mi nono-kai, apa' moroho pepangala'-ni hi Pue' Yesus.

Uma mowo kagoe'-kai mpokagoe'-koi ompi'. Jadi', napa to ma'ala kihiwili-ki Alata'ala ngkai hawe'ea kagoea' to nawai'-kakai toe? Uma ria ntani'-na, muntu' mpo'uli' tarima kasi-kai hi rala posampaya-kai hi Alata'ala Tuama-ta.
Hinamengi hina'eo-kai merapi' hi Alata'ala hante nono mpu'u bona nabea ohea-kai mpencuai'-koi, bona kipohonoi' to kura' hi pepangala'-ni.
Mosampaya-kai hi Alata'ala Tuama-ta pai' hi Pue'-ta Pue' Yesus, kiperapi' bona nabea-kakai ohea mpohirua'-kokoi ompi'.
Kiperapi' bona katedoo–donihia ahi'-ni, alaa-na momepoka'ahi' mpu'u-koi hadua bo hadua, pai'-koi mpoka'ahi' hawe'ea tauna, hewa ahi'-kai hi koi'.
Kiperapi' hi Alata'ala bona narohoi nono-ni, bona moroli'-koi hante uma ria kasalaia'-ni hi nyanyoa-na ane rata-ipi mpai' Pue' Yesus hante hawe'ea topetuku'-na to moroli'.

Ka'omea-na ompi', kiperapi' bona nituku' hawa'–hawa' to ni'epe-mi ngkai kai', bona po'ingku-ni mpotuku' konoa Alata'ala. Kakoo–kono-na, lompe'-mi po'ingku-ni toe lau. Aga hante kuasa to nawai'-kakai Pue' Yesus, kiperapi' pai' kiparesai' mpu'u-koi bona nidonihii tena-pidi kalompe' po'ingku-ni toe-e.
Ni'inca-mi tudui' to oti kiparata-kokoi hante kuasa Pue' Yesus.
Tohe'i konoa Alata'ala, bona moroli' katuwu'-ta, neo'-hawo mogau' sala' hante toronaa ba hante tobine doo.
Butu dua tomane kana mpodoo lompe' tobine-ra, ntuku' ohea to lompe' hi poncilo Alata'ala pai' hi poncilo manusia'.
Neo' napakeni hina nono-ta to dada'a, hewa to biasa jadi' hi tauna to uma mpo'incai Alata'ala.
Hi gau' tomane pai' tobine toe, neo'-ta mpobabehi to sala' hi doo ba mpobagiu doo. Oti-mi kipolonto'-kokoi wengi pehuku'-na Alata'ala hi tauna to mogau' hewa toe.

Apa' napa patuju-na Alata'ala mpokio'-ta ompi'? Uma-ta nakio' bona mogau' sala'. Nakio'-tale pai' nawai'-ta Inoha'-na to moroli', bona moroli' katuwu'-ta. Jadi', hema to mposapuaka tudui' tohe'i-e, uma-i mposapuaka manusia'. Alata'ala-hana to nasapuaka.
Kakaliliua-na ompi', ane gau' mpoka'ahi' ompi' hampepangalaa'-ta, kakono-na uma-pi-hawo mingki' ki'uki'-kokoi ba apa–apa. Apa' Alata'ala mpotudui'-koi momepoka'ahi' hadua bo hadua.
Nipoka'ahi' hawe'ea ompi' hampepangalaa'-ni hi Makedonia. Aga kiperapi' mpu'u ompi', bona nidonihii tena-pidi po'ingku-ni tetu.
Pelompehi mpu'u bona tuwu' hintuwu' hante doo. Penonoi bago-ni moto, neo' mpogalo urusia doo. Mobago mpali' pongkoni'-ni, hewa to oti-mi kitudui'-kokoie wengi.
Ane hewa toe po'ingku-ni, uma-koi mpai' karapi'–rapi' hi doo. Pai' tauna to uma mepangala' hi Pue' Yesus mpobila'-koi.
Ompi'–ompi', patuju-kai bona ni'inca mpu'u-hawo napa to jadi' hi doo-ta to mate, bona neo' susa' rahi nono-ni hewa tauna to uma ncarumaka Alata'ala.

Taparasaya Yesus mate-imi pai' tuwu' nculii'-i. Toe pai' taparasaya bate toe wo'o mpai' to jadi' hi hawe'ea tauna to mate-mi to mepangala' hi Yesus. Ane tumai-i mpai' Pue' Yesus, Alata'ala mpokeni-ra tumai hangkaa–ngkania hante Hi'a.
Tohe'i-mi tudui' to kitarima ngkai Pue' Yesus. Ane rata nculii'-ipi mpai' Pue', kita' to tuwu'-pidi nto'u toe, uma-ta meri'ulu ngkai doo-ta to mpolia' mate-mi.
Apa' ane mana'u-ipi mpai' Pue' tumai ngkai suruga, ta'epe pekio' tadulako mala'eka hante moni sangkakala Alata'ala. Pai' hi tanda toe, tuwu' nculii'-ramo tomate to mepangala' hi Kristus.
Oti toe-di, kita' to tuwu'-pidi ra'ore' dohe-ra hilou hi rala limu' mpohirua'-ki Pue' hi lolo raoa. Pai' tida-tamo dohe Pue' duu' kahae–hae-na.
Jadi' ngkai toe-mi ompi', mometanta'u-mokoi hadua bo hadua hante lolita tohe'e.
Ompi' omea, uma mingki' ki'uki'-kokoi ba nto'uma mpu'u eo karataa Pue'.
Apa' ni'inca moto ompi': hewa karataa topanako ngkabengia, wae wo'o mpai' Eo Karataa Pue', konce mpai' ihi' dunia' nakaratai.

Rata mpai' tempo-na, tauna mpo'uli': "Lompe' moto katuwu'-ta, uma ria to tapoka'eka'." Ntaa' we'i, nto'u toe-midi kanarumpa'-ra silaka-e! Tohe'e mpai' jadi' ncorobaa, hewa pontodohaka tobine to neo' mo'ana'. Uma ria ohea-ra mpasalewa huku'-ra.
Aga koi', ompi', uma-koi hi rala kabengia-na. Uma-koi mpai' konce hi eo karataa Pue' Yesus, hewa hi karataa topanako.
Mobaja-mi nono-ni omea, mo'ingku-koi hewa tauna to momako' hi eo-na. Uma-ta hewa tauna to mpobabehi gau' to dada'a hi rala kabengia-na.
Jadi', mo'inga'–inga'-ta pai' mpakanoto nono-ta. Neo'-ta leta' hewa tauna to hi rala kabengia-na-pidi.
Apa' tauna to turu pai' malangu, turu pai' malangu hi bengi-na.

Tapi' kita' toi-e, tauna to hi rala kabajaa-na. Toe pai' kana tapakanoto nono-ta. Kana tapomotede' mpu'u pepangala'-ta hi Pue' pai' ahi'-ta hi doo, bona moroho-ta hewa tantara to mpobaju baju ahe'. Kana ncarumaka-ta Alata'ala, kanawai'-nata kalompea' hi eo mpeno-na, bona moroho-ta hewa tantara to mosongkoi songko ahe'.
Kana tapakanoto nono-ta, apa' Alata'ala uma mpelihi-ta bona mporata roe-na. Napelihi-tale bona nahore-ta ngkai huku' jeko'-ta pai' nawai'-ta kalompea' sabana petolo' Pue'-ta Yesus Kristus.
Yesus Kristus mate mpotolo'-ta, bona ane rata-ipi mpai', tuwu' hangkaa–ngkania hante Hi'a-tamo, ba tuwu'-ta-pidi nto'u toe ba mpolia' mate-tamo.
Toe-mi ompi', mome'apui-koi, pai' momerohoi mponono-mokoi, hewa to nibabehi-mi toe-e lau.
Ompi'–ompi', kiperapi' bona nibila'-ra to mpokamu bago Pue' hi laintongo'-ni, apa' hira' to jadi' totu'a-ni hi rala Pue' pai' to mpoparesai'-koi.
Bila' pai' pengkorui mpu'u-ra, pai' poka'ahi'-ra sabana pobago-ra toe. Tuwu' hintuwu' hadua bo hadua.
Ompi', kiperapi' bona niparesai'-ra-rawo to lose mobago. Apui-ra to mere' nono-ra. Pe'inte'-ra to lente pepangala'-ra. Mosabara hi hawe'ea tauna.
Ane ria to mogau' dada'a hi kita', neo' tapehawai hante gau' to dada'a wo'o. Agina-pi tababehi oa' to lompe' hi doo-ta pai' hi hawe'ea tauna.
Kana goe' ncuu-ta,
tida mosampaya,
pai' mpo'uli' tarima kasi hi Alata'ala nau' ba napa to jadi', apa' toe-mi konoa Alata'ala hi kita' to mosidai' hante Kristus Yesus.
Neo' nilawa' pobago Inoha' Tomoroli'.
Neo' uma nisaile' lolita tauna ane mpohowa'-ra Lolita Alata'ala.
Pekiri lompe' butu mela-na, niponciloi ba ngkai Alata'ala mpu'u-di ba bela-di, pai' kakamu to lompe'.
Pelelii' hawe'ea kehi to dada'a.

Mekakae-a hi Alata'ala to mpowai'-ta kalompea' tuwu', kuperapi' bona napakaroli' kehi-ni, duu'-na moroli' mpu'u-koi. Kuperapi' bona napewili'-koi, lompe' woto-ni lompe' nono ba kao'-ni, bona uma ria kasalaia'-ni nau' hangkedi' ane rata nculii'-ipi Pue'-ta Yesus Kristus.
Alata'ala mpokio'-ta mpotuku'-i. Jadi', Hi'a wo'o-wadi to mpopadupa' hawe'ea tohe'e, apa' napadupa' oa' janci-na.
Ompi'–ompi', kiperapi' bona niposampayai wo'o-ka-kaiwo.
Parata-kaka-kaiwo tabe-kai pai' ahi'-kai hi hawe'ea ompi' hi rala Pue' Yesus to hi retu-ra.
Hante kuasa to nawai'-ka Pue', kuperapi' bona sura toi nibasa hi nyanyoa hawe'ea ompi' hampepangalaa' to hi retu-ra.
Pue'-ta Yesus Kristus mpogane'-koi.
